reviews.text: The Roguelike Deckbuilding Dungeon Crawler that you've been looking for.

Their previous game, Forward Escape the Fold was just excellent. I had the chance of trying Pyrene's demo a little while ago and it seemed to be a really good improvement. It's exactly my type of game and I'm happy to report that it plays very well and seems to have tons of content. Gotta catch back to where I was in the demo but I just want more of it.

我只能说喜欢卡牌肉鸽的必入。 1.简介明了的画风下又不失策略，每一步都要思索最优解，用最小的损失最大化回报。 2.安静舒缓的音乐让人内心安逸，心情舒畅。 3.融合了市面上很多肉鸽的特色，又不让人觉得繁琐鸡肋。地图版块的随机，构建卡组diy单卡，怪物刷新机制，遗物装备，特定环境不同的规则（比如有下雨天，山地，迷雾等，规则都有所不同），甚至还有建造，让人有动力去反复游玩，新鲜感十足。 4.角色初始属性通过解锁建筑可以自定义，幸运，防御，卡牌负重，血量、食物都可以根据自己喜好更改。 5.官方很多小的细节可以看出真心为各类玩家人群去考虑，主打让你玩的开心。比如自带作弊系统，可以设置无敌，超上限，不受规则移动等等，当然还有困难模式系统，自己可以勾选一些苛刻规则来加大游戏难度，比如给怪加盾牌，增加每次过夜食物消耗，获得的金币能量全部少1等，为喜欢挑战自我提供了多种选项。探索过的房间，一键传送（不需要你还去寻找传送石之类的东西，自带传送），省去走重复回头路的无聊时间。 6.丰富的内容，7大职业各有特色40多个人物技能，200多个遗物神器待你发现。100多张卡牌任你搭配，12大生态群落地供你探索。 唯一没有中文，虽然游戏翻译需求不太大，基本玩着就会了，但是还是希望有中文，能流畅看懂文本，代入感会更好。 所有最后还是重要的事情说三遍：we need chinese,we need chinses,we need chinese please PS：想要个撤回键或者可以花钱买复活，经常手快点错导致伙伴死亡，一步错步步错啊！Want to recall button,or I can spend gold coins to revive my partner. PS:通关了主线剧情后竟然还有惊喜，我就不多说了，给你们保留惊喜，自己去体会吧！

Overall very fun game, loved the demo, but the 'Cave' zone ruins it for me. The most fun part about the game is planning and executing pathing based on your deck, and calculating risk/reward for more or less votive shards, but not being able to see the board in the cave reduces the gameplay loop down to a random, frustrating, luck based slog. If the zone gets removed or rebalanced in a way that makes it fun, I'll change my review.

This one didn't really click for me. I found the pacing really annoying where I couldn't tell if the game wanted me to run through levels or take my time going through them. Most of the fights are pretty brain dead easy but you'll eventually zone out and not realize that you accidentally didn't leave a card path to the exit and die from having to rest or something like that. I find that most of my runs just end from me going through the motions and not because i came across an interesting fight.

This game has a ton of potential and really fun mechanics, but the balance just makes the fun die off at about 5-6 hours in. I'm not going to say that all in roguelikes all runs should be possible to win, but this game is so hard that realistically the best strategy is to just give up and start over if you don't get a good first two chests. There doesn't seem to be any power level meta-progression, just more card/relics unlocks for variety, so I can't see what I'm missing. I'm at something like a 20% win rate right now to just *progress the story* which is so frustrating that I just can't find myself enjoying it. It just feels like the game was rebalanced at the last minute without any playtesting or something - I've played many of my runs mathematically perfectly and died in the first zone. There are a few bosses that are *literally* impossible unless you get specific card/relic combos. This is just not good game design.

This game is extremely clever in it's core mechanics and adds a ton of variety on top of it. Try the demo for sure, and if you want that but with a lot more content, know the full game is for you. The biggest strength of this game is that each area and character feel very different. In terms of areas: in the mountain, cards fall down when the card below them goes away. In the cave, your vision goes away unless you pick up torches. In the dark woods, you can teleport to a Firefly mirroring your location. Characters are very varied as well. You start with the generalist, but among the others there's a pet class, someone who pushes all cards in the direction they move in, and someone who moves randomly. These elements all combine to make interesting puzzles in every room. The push-your-luck mechanic is also pretty fun! After getting enough cards in a zone, the ending card comes up. You can leave, OR, you can empower it by killing more monsters. Since you'll be low on provisions at this point, you likely have to replenish the field using your health. Seeing how many extra monsters you can kill and empower the chest with is a lot of fun, and necessary for winning. There is one 'problem' with the game. This is the easiest game I've played to 'go infinite' on. Tons of fun builds break the game entirely, but maybe [i]too[/i] easily. For example: A relic that applies a burn if someone survives damage + a relic that deals damage when an enemy gets burned DOES loop. Still, fun game, highly recommend.
Hidden gem that you will not regret purchasing. Story ends about 20 hours in if you take your time, several completionist challenges after that

so i enjoyed this game. until i found out it was broken. i LOVE card battle games and even tho this is not really a card battle game. like most it was fun. then i found a char that does not take resources to sleep, and you can put bleed on all enemies every time you move, and you can have bleed give you a shield, and you can have the bleed act instantly. so every time i move it kills everything & i can wipe the board and start over FOREVER. the shrine at the end of each fight i can get to 200+ every time and maxed out my gold. i've only played for 7 hours. but there is no need to go any farther. the games broken and no fun when nothing gives you a challenge.

The game was pretty mid. The campaign is short and after that it offers nothing but a couple of challenge modes. There isn't really any deck building, as you just get a handful of cards throughout the run and you just choose the strongest ones, no matter what "strategy" you're going for (there are no strategies, just overpowered legendaries and 2-card combos) and your success depends on getting an overpowered legendary or 2-card combo early. I also massively disliked the survival aspect after you beat a stage. You basically have to beat as many enemies as possible before going to the exit to get the best rewards. This means that if you didn't get lucky early and pulled one of the OP legendary cards, your chances of getting a legendary decreases the further you go, as the stages get harder and your rewards get worse. Meanwhile getting an early legendary ensures that you get drowned in more and more legendaries and just snowball out of control. The balance of the game is a mess overall and combat gets repetitive quite fast. Stages just drag on and on with no strategic depth.

I enjoyed the demo pretty well so I bought this. However after the first couple of hours/characters the fun was gone for me. The challenge went away quickly. Game play felt very repeatitive and formulaic. The story was painfully predictable and felt preachy.

The idea is good, position based card game. I am trending negative on it for the following reasons. -No undo button. I am old and an idiot and i have recently adopted a cat that likes to sit on my keyboard. Playing with the mouse alleviates this a bit but I prefer the keyboard. -Enemies all feel the same. Even the bosses. They are just a number on a card. -The effects/strategies of the decks all feel the same. It doesn't feel unique or good to pull off your combo it feels exactly like doing it for the other build paths. (Thorns Burn Bleed) They just feel like a number you activate by clicking a different button. -Sense of progression is uninteresting. I collect wood to upgrade buildings but half the time it doesn't even unlock anything because the secondary triggers aren't met. The game is OK. I got 7 hours out of it, maybe despite its flaws if it held my interest to 10 (my minimum hours played for a positive review) i would sing a different song.

Game has good arts and an intentional play styles.You can easily learn the rule and play well. However, the mode that you need to kill more enemies to get better award, brings that hundreds of repeat, quickly kills my will to play. Meanwhile, the increasing food needs and limit cards position make the deck building meaningless, I think I can even play better without my cards. A new way to let cards in the deck appear more reasonable is needed. The balance in this version is just a mess overall.

游戏以类似card hog，在一个可做机制极其有限的基本框架下，尽可能塞入更多的玩法。相对于类杀戮尖塔这种常见的打牌DBG，它有着更强的puzzle感。但对于card hog，它的运营和构筑成分非常重，且通过诸多机制减轻解密增重策略（体现在不存在“唯一正确的解”，而是要根据局势和情况权衡风险和收益，并在此基础上进行决策） 这款游戏的上限被底层机制所限制，经常能构筑出极其逆天的构筑。但针对可重复游玩设计，制作组也并没有照搬杀戮尖塔，单纯通过摁加数值来提升难度。而是通过恰到好处的内容释放节奏，和丰富的玩法，让玩家面临一个又一个挑战。一个挑战可以理解为：在设定的规则下，如何用特定的角色，在理解之下构筑，闯过组合丰富的战斗遭遇。别的不说，就单说角色，基本可以说每个角色都类似节奏地牢的角色般有巨大的差异，相当多角色干脆直接修改游戏的基本逻辑。 最初随着主线，玩家会逐步解锁关卡机制、敌人种类和玩法迥异的角色。当主线通关后（通常已经花费接近10个小时），又会解锁挑战和高难模式。挑战相当于给与一个极其特殊的设定，玩家需要专为为此进行构筑以通关。高难模式则是一定程度类似哈迪斯的热度系统，但最高只有10，且每条都经过专门设计，并非单纯数值增幅。且从成就和设计上看，设计组是把全角色10难度通关作为最终封盘挑战。 整体来说，这款游戏给我一种“基本框架就这样的前提下，看看能在此基础上整出多少活”的感觉。事实上，也的确整了不少活，且确实活整得很好

Nice concept but ultimately lacks depth. Encounters all feel very samey and the deckcrafting is not deep at all. I'm very on the fence on this one. The concept is unique and fun, the devs clearly cared about this when making it, but the game really needs something extra.

At first, it was pretty good. You really have to think before you move. Exploring new upgrades and the talisman system was pretty fun. After the campaign, there are lots of options to tweak with to increase replay value. That's also where the game peaks. Tt doesn't feel that different most of the time afterwards. Character and item balance is not okay. There are a few occasions, that bald dude is just purely luck-based when the tiles you can move on is random. By that time, you unlocked more powerful items too, the game becomes quite repetitive. After getting certain items and mods, either you win by just walking 8 outta 10 times. Otherwise, you know you have to start over after the first biome because scaling is not fast enough. And then you start to lose focus/patience and mess up more easily. The character illustrations and design is mid at best and did not save the gameplay at all. The worst is the looping background music. The first game I played in silence and felt better.

比较有意思的游戏，不过数值上有点崩坏？目前为止我游戏时间4小时，但是实际只玩了3个半小时，为什么？因为游戏中有一些指数/平方增长的配合，轻松的牌的数值叠上去之后，看了半小时的效果动画。 有一个消耗资源复制牌的技能，有一个给所有卡牌升级的牌钢锭（这张牌是平方次数升级，给所有牌升级X次X点，其中升级钢锭提升X）。逆天的是钢锭的复制品可以升级自己，这样我轻松的搞了一个999等级的钢锭（给所有牌升级999次999级）。于是我现在还在看着钢钉升级的动画中
乍一看还行，实则不能细品，遗物卡牌之间的联动很一般，不同套路成型全靠运气，同时游游戏中也充满了运气因素，一旦卡牌多了会优先给很多牌却不刷怪，总之哪哪都很怪，很多地方都欠打磨

The pathfinding puzzle is fun, but it loses its novelty pretty soon. The mechanics, cards, relics, and monsters are pretty generic. It's hard to strategize because the impact of RNG is too big, and I would often find myself in a dead end although the run was smooth. And it's hard to call it a proper deck builder too — you don't cycle through cards fast enough, and it's hard to build meaningful combos and synergies.

I wish there was a more nuanced rating in Steam. I unlocked every character and completed the story and village. This was a cute game, original mechanics, interesting characters and play styles but ultimately very poorly balanced. Dodge is incredibly overpowered, as it avoids all combat damage AND combat debuffs and can be triggered by basic components like sleeping or using abilities. So each run either killed me in the first zone, or made me so powerful I could ignore most of the battles as I farmed resources. Well, I also died at least once to each new enemy and curse mechanic as I learned how they worked. There's a wide variety but... I don't even remember being challenged by any of the bosses. Cute, but needs half of the talismans and relics removed and the rest rebalanced. For example, 2nd playthrough with the shape changer I bought a relic that triggered rest when using an ability. And another that gave me dodge when I rested. This nullified the uniqueness of the shapeshifting abilities (as they reset on rest), but let me play each battle until I was done farming resources. Much like with every other character. If you can't get dodge, then frost is nearly as powerful. The only limiter for most of my characters was the number of "basic" rests I could do which "usually" bypass shields when they cost health. There's two characters (at least?) that _by default_ don't even have those limitations. There's a comprehensive challenge system and the ability to fine-tune many options, but I expect they will not adequately target the semi-reliable paths to godhood.

I love this game. Every character is unique and plays different. Every biome is unique too, and requires a whole different strategy. You unlock more characters organically when you play the story, and I am pleasantly surprised at the amount of content this game has. it's replayable, you can increase the difficulty as you get more familiar with the character you play (or make it easier... I really had issues with finishing a run with Malo) If you like strategy, card games, puzzles, dungeon-crawlers or deckbuilding games - I recommend this one. Bonus: by playing you support a small (I think 3 person-team) indie studio, based in france.

Pyrene is everything I love about indie games. It was made by a small development studio that clearly did the best they could with limited resources. They made smart decisions regarding the game’s scope while still creating a surprisingly rich and immersive world filled with memorable characters, cards, relics, and a plethora of customization options to experiment with during each run. If you want to dive deeper after finishing the story, there’s plenty of replayability and build variety to keep you engaged. As for the gameplay, I really enjoyed the combat mechanics and the overall gameplay loop. The game doesn’t reinvent the roguelike formula, but if you already enjoy roguelikes, you’ll feel right at home after just a few runs. The standard difficulty is fairly forgiving, but I had a lot of fun creating ridiculously overpowered builds right from the start. Some characters are definitely easier to use than others, though. I don’t see myself getting completely addicted to it the way I did with classics like Slay the Spire, but it’s absolutely a game I would recommend and one I’ll gladly return to from time to time.
